string.text: If you are able to track down and defeat The Roman Mercenaries you will be rewarded with 10x of the Ancient Ballista Plans. If this item is in your inventory, you will be able to deploy 6x powerful ballistas during any field battle. To deploy the ballistas you must have at least 20x troops so that you are given the formation screen. Once on this screen, place your #1 infantry formation in your chosen position, and then press K. This will deploy the ballistas directly in front of your infantry formation. The AI will automatically start using the ballistas as soon as the battle starts. You can also order them to move once the battle has started, but it is better to place them where you want before the battle starts. YOU DO NOT NEED TO EQUIP THE ITEM. Just have it in your inventory.

The Roman Mercenaries are a powerful band of fanatical roman soldiers, veterans of the defeat at Manzikert in 1071. This party will rome the lands around Trebizond, hoping to one day restore the glory of the empire and avenge their defeat. If you defeat this party you will be rewarded with the Ancient Ballista Plans. This item will allow you to deploy power ballistas during any field battle. Search the encyclopedia for field ballistas for more information.
